## recommendation

1. M: submit sam-tagger 0.7.0 to bioconda — the meta.yaml is sha256-ready;
   use the upload-to-bioconda skill.
2. L: on future releases, expect the release workflow to auto-create the
   GitHub release on tag push — use `gh release edit` for curated notes
   instead of `create`.
3. L: run `ruff format` on changed files only — the repo is not format-clean
   under the current ruff, and blanket runs rewrite unrelated files.
